speaker: control
text: Falcon One, this is Control. You are cleared for takeoff.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, runway is clear. Cleared for takeoff.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, proceed to the target area. Good hunting.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, intercept the civilian aircraft. Weapons hold. I repeat, weapons hold.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, cleared for approach. Bring her in.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, disengage and return to base.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, Control. Return to base. Bring it home.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, bandits inbound. Stay sharp.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, hostile aircraft approaching your position.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, SAM launch! Missile inbound. Break, break!

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, surface to air missile inbound! Deploy countermeasures!

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, missile inbound! Break hard. Countermeasures!

speaker: control
text: Nice work, pilot. Mission objectives complete. Return to base.

speaker: control
text: Outstanding work, Falcon One. The job is done. Bring it home.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, abort the mission. Bring that damaged bird home, pilot.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, you are taking structural damage. Disengage and bring her home.

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, your weapons are down. Disengage and return to base.

speaker: pilot
text: Roger that, sir.

speaker: pilot
text: Wilco, sir. Returning to base.

speaker: pilot
text: Copy that, Control.

speaker: pilot
text: Missile away!

speaker: pilot
text: Falcon One. Missile away.

speaker: pilot
text: In hot. Bombs away.

speaker: pilot
text: Falcon One, commencing bombing run. Bombs away.

speaker: pilot
text: Guns, guns, guns!

speaker: pilot
text: Falcon One, engaging with guns.

speaker: pilot
text: Mayday, Mayday! Flight controls are gone. I am going down!

speaker: pilot
text: Control, Falcon One! I have lost control. I am going down!

speaker: wingman
text: Falcon Two, ready. On your wing.

speaker: wingman
text: Falcon Two, taking fire! I am under attack!

speaker: wingman
text: Mayday! Falcon Two is going down!

speaker: civilian
text: This is the civilian aircraft. I made a navigation error. I am turning back and leaving your airspace immediately. Please, do not fire!

speaker: control
text: Falcon One, welcome home, pilot. Good to have you back.

speaker: pilot
text: Control, Falcon One. I'm flying blind. My navigation signal is being jammed!

speaker: pilot
text: Mayday, Falcon One! I am stalled and losing altitude. Attempting recovery!

speaker: pilot
text: Mayday! Falcon One, I am losing control. I am going down!
